   <media:title>Step up to the plate with Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh</media:title>
   <media:content url="https://www.youtube.com/v/Ay6JlZM4Qks?version=3" type="application/x-shockwave-flash" width="640" height="390"/>
   <media:thumbnail url="https://i2.ytimg.com/vi/Ay6JlZM4Qks/hqdefault.jpg" width="480" height="360"/>
   <media:description>In baseball, stepping up to the plate means it's your turn to make a difference. Seattle @mariners catcher Cal Raleigh knows that better than most. We invited leaders from eight Washington state nonprofits for an at-bat with Cal. Between swings, they shared who they're stepping up for, the toughest pitches they face, and who's in their lineup.

For Microsoft employees, stepping up for the causes they care about happens all year long. Last year in Washington, they contributed $88.2M to nonprofits, including the company match, and volunteered more than 477K hours to support nonprofits across our home state.

Watch more: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTzEvfY6qhC4</media:description>
